boolean_projection_theorem.boolean_projection: Therefore b_{P,k}(q)=# {m in I_q(P,k): m composite, LPF(m)>=7} belongs to {0,1}.
boolean_projection_theorem.not_enough: Boolean coefficients alone do not prove cancellation; a prime-q subset reciprocal phase theorem or a completion theorem is still needed.
boolean_projection_theorem.phase_reduction: Finite sawtooth modes reduce to sums over a subset Q_{P,k} of primes q in (P/2,P), not to a multi-weighted prime sequence.
boolean_projection_theorem.residual_parity: If m is composite and LPF(m)>=7, then m is odd and coprime to 2,3,5.
boolean_projection_theorem.window_bound: For q>P/2, I_q(P,k) has at most two integers; if two occur they are consecutive.
